# Candidate Show HN post

Title: Show HN: One click flight booking in Claude
Project URL: https://mcp.bonbook.co/claude-setup
Posted (UTC): 2026-10-20T23:36:17Z

## Project page text (fetch status: ok)

```text
Three steps. About one minute. No account or password.
Open Claude
and go to
Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector
.
Paste this address
into the URL box and click
Add
.
Copy
Name it
BonBook Travel
. Leave everything else empty.
Click Connect.
A BonBook page appears for a second and closes by itself. You're done.
Now start a new chat and ask for a flight, for example:
Find me a flight from Austin to Los Angeles next Friday, one way.
Your first booking opens a secure bonbook.co checkout page. After that, just say “book option 2”.
```

## HN discussion (2 comments)

- [other] arlattimore: Who processes the booking & payment, an aggregator like Expedia or the airlines direct?
- [author] themagyar: Airlines process and charge your card directly. So a booking on Delta shows up as 'Delta Air Lines' and you keep credit card points.

<think>This is a candidate Show HN post. Let me evaluate whether to push or pass.

The product is "One click flight booking in Claude". It's a custom MCP connector that lets you search and book flights directly within Claude. 

Why push?
- It's an interesting small product — a clever integration of flight booking into an LLM via MCP (Model Context Protocol). 
- It meets a specific, easily overlooked need: being able to book a flight within a chat interface with one click.
- The author explains it's a direct airline booking (not an aggregator), so you get credit card points.
- It's a useful sample of what people are building now — using MCP connectors to add real-world functionality (flight booking) to LLMs.
- It looks professional and solid enough.

Why pass?
- Narrow audience (people who use Claude and want to book flights through it).
- Could be seen as just a wrapper around airline APIs.

Verdict: push. The MCP connector approach is interesting and it's a creative way to integrate flight booking into a chat interface. It's a good example of what people are building now.

Let me write the reason in Chinese.</think>{"decision": "push", "reason": "这是一个将订票功能集成到 Claude 中的 MCP 连接器，演示了如何通过模型上下文协议为 LLM 添加实用的实际功能，不仅能直接向航司订票（保留信用卡积分），还是一个很直观的 AI 应用示例。"}
